name: Z Achilles
description: The classic armored warrior of the stadium. Z Achilles uses its dual wing-swords to balance offensive driving power with an unyielding center of gravity, adapting seamlessly to any opponent it faces.

ability.name: Aether Stance
ability.description: Z Achilles begins the match with +50 bonus Defense. After executing its Special Move, permanently drops the defense bonus and switches into an aggressive stance, gaining +50 Attack for the rest of the battle. Also heals 25 HP on stance switch.

chain._note: post_special_attack_buff: +50 ATK permanently after Special fires

special_move.name: Z-Breaker
special_move.description: Utilizes its dual metal blade extensions to unleash a symmetrical twin-strike that cuts across the entire arena track.
flavour_texts: ⚔️ **Z-Breaker** — The twin swords flash under the stadium lights!
💥 A perfectly balanced double strike pushes the foe back!
